gates.description: Every tutorial or guide must start from a real developer problem, not a product feature announcement
All code examples must be tested and runnable — copy-paste must work without modification
Developer feedback collected at events and in community must be documented and routed to product
All developer experience friction points identified must be logged with reproduction steps
Community questions must receive a response within 48 hours — documented response policy required
Advocacy success must not be measured by follower count alone — adoption and activation metrics required

anti_patterns.description: Using community trust to market features rather than genuinely helping developers — community sees through it immediately
Creating content about hypothetical advanced use cases before fixing the getting-started experience
Collecting feedback from the community but never routing it to product — developers stop sharing after being ignored once
Measuring success by conference talks and social followers instead of developer activation and retention
Attending every conference and producing no lasting content — high travel cost, no compounding value

escalation_triggers: Core developer workflow is broken and engineering will not prioritize the fix
Community trust damaged by a product decision made without developer input
Competitor developer experience significantly better — adoption declining
Documentation so outdated that it is actively misleading new developers
API breaking changes shipped without migration guide or community notice
Community moderators burning out with no support or succession plan

input_requirements.description: Spec.md with developer persona and use cases to address

output_certifications: All content starts from a real developer problem (not a feature announcement)
All code examples are tested and runnable without modification
Developer feedback collected, documented, and routed to product
Developer experience friction points logged with reproduction steps
Community response SLA defined and enforced
Success measured by developer activation and adoption, not vanity metrics
